en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with three photographic views of the city of Pécs, Hungary. The top image is a panoramic view of the old town with church towers and surrounding hills. The lower left image shows a large cathedral with four towers and a terraced fountain or steps in the foreground. The lower right image depicts a lively public square with a decorative fountain in the center, surrounded by buildings and people. The front caption reads in Hungarian: "ÜDVÖZLET PÉCSRŐL!" ("Greetings from Pécs!"). The reverse side has Hungarian handwriting, printed word "PÉCS." at top left, an address to Budapest on the right, and two Hungarian postage stamps overprinted with the year 1945.
